# Green Leaf Lawn Care

> Residential lawn care company based in Maple Grove, Minnesota, serving the northwest Twin Cities suburbs. Weekly mowing, fertilization, aeration, and seasonal cleanup with upfront pricing and the same crew every visit. No contracts required.

## Services & starting prices

- Lawn Mowing & Edging — from $45 / visit
- Fertilization & Weed Control — from $65 / treatment
- Aeration & Overseeding — from $180 flat
- Fall Leaf Removal — from $90 / visit
- Spring Cleanup — from $120 flat
- Snow Removal — from $60 / visit

Final price depends on lot size and service frequency. Get an exact quote at https://alectronic-solutions.github.io/Green-Leaf-Lawn-Care/#quote

## Service area

Maple Grove, Plymouth, Brooklyn Park, Osseo, Champlin, Dayton, Brooklyn Center, New Hope, and Crystal, Minnesota. Homeowners just outside these cities can call to check availability.

- Phone: (763) 555-0142

- Saturday: 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM

## Policies

- No contracts — pause, skip, or cancel service with 48 hours' notice.
- Licensed and insured for fertilizer and herbicide application in Minnesota.
- Service issues corrected free of charge if reported within 48 hours of a visit.
